_about: platform/icon_id -> manifest fields replacing the platform defaults, for icons not taken from that platform's current pack. Read by generate_manifest.py.

aws/simpledb.name: Amazon SimpleDB
aws/simpledb.source: AWS Simple Icons (the official AWS icon set before AWS Architecture Icons); SimpleDB is in no Architecture Icons release
aws/simpledb.note: Legacy style (pre-2018). Service still runs but receives no new icon.

aws/snowmobile.name: AWS Snowmobile
aws/snowmobile.source: AWS Architecture Icons, 2024 pack (via npm aws-icons 2.1.0); retired service, no longer in the current pack

aws/quicksight.name: Amazon QuickSight
aws/quicksight.source: AWS Architecture Icons, 2025 pack (via npm aws-icons 3.2.0); now part of Amazon Quick Suite, see quick-suite
aws/quicksight.note: Renamed into Amazon Quick Suite; use quick-suite for the current product.
